hook: Teach your kids this money trick
voiceover: Every wealthy family should teach its kids this trick. How fast does money double? Take seventy-two. Divide it by the yearly return. Six percent? Seventy-two divided by six is twelve. It doubles in about twelve years. Nine percent? About eight years. Now the scary part. A card at twenty-four percent doubles what you owe in about three years. That's the rule of seventy-two. It's an estimate, but it's close. Comment WEALTH for the free calculator.
ctaText: I’ll DM you the free calculator
caption: Rule of 72: years to double ≈ 72 ÷ yearly rate. 6% → ~12 yrs. 9% → ~8 yrs. 24% card debt → ~3 yrs. Teach it to your kids. Quick estimate, not a promise. Comment WEALTH for the calculator. I'm an AI character. Education only.

sources: Math: exact doubling time ln2/ln(1+r): 6% = 11.9 yrs, 9% = 8.04 yrs, 24% = 3.2 yrs; rule of 72 gives 12, 8, 3
